reference: The Injury (S2E12): Michael steps onto his George Foreman grill (he keeps bacon on it overnight to wake up to cooked bacon) and burns his foot; he calls Pam to come pick him up.

evidence.line: Michael: OK, buhhhh, I burned my foot very badly on my Foreman Grill and I now need someone to come and bring me into work.
Michael: ... Today I got up, I stepped onto the grill and it clamped down on my foot... that's it.

caveats: Later callbacks (Ben Franklin S3E14 sc.28, Beach Games S3E22 sc.52) refer back to it; the injury itself is in The Injury.
question: In which episode does Michael burn his foot on a George Foreman grill?
